title: Who Trades at the Close? Implications for Price Discovery and Liquidity
one_line: Closing auctions grew from 3.1% (2010) to 7.5% (2018) of US stock volume, driven by indexing and ETFs; auction prices usually sit at the pre-close bid/ask and auction price deviations revert quickly and almost completely.

findings.statement: Auction price deviations revert almost fully and quickly.
S&P 500 inclusion raises auction volume permanently.

why.pattern: Passive/index flows concentrate at the close.
